questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Georgia?

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Georgia?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter A and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Georgia article.

questions.proof: It is situated on the coast of the Black Sea and borders Russia to the north, Turkey and Armenia to the south, and Azerbaijan to the southeast.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Georgia?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter G and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Culture” part of the Georgia article.

questions.proof: People from Georgia are called Georgians, most of whom speak Georgian as their first language, though some speak Azerbaijani, Armenian, Russian or other languages as well.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Georgia considers both regions as occupied by _____.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter R and has 6 letters.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In the 1500s, the Persians invaded eastern Georgia four times from _____ to 1544.”

questions.proof: In the 1500s, the Persians invaded eastern Georgia four times from 1541 to 1544.
